blocks.title: Everything a small business needs to bill faster, collect better, and grow smarter.

features.title: Super Fast Billing
features.description: Create bills in seconds with calculator-based and item-wise billing for faster checkout.

features.description: Track customer dues, manage pending payments, and send payment reminders easily.

features.title: Daily Income Tracking
features.description: Monitor daily sales, profit, expenses, and payment status with smart reports.

features.title: AI Business Insights
features.description: Get intelligent business suggestions and analytics to improve growth and profits.

blocks.title: Choose your workspace
blocks.description: Start on your phone with Smart Billing Lite, or take your business further on the web with SmartBill Pro.

blocks.title: Frequently Asked Questions
blocks.description: Everything you need to know about Smart Billing Lite.

items.question: What is Smart Billing Lite?
items.answer: Smart Billing Lite is an AI-powered mobile billing app for Indian small businesses, with billing, UPI and QR payments, receipt printing, udhaar tracking, and daily reports.

items.question: Can I print thermal receipts from the app?
items.answer: Yes. Smart Billing Lite supports Bluetooth and USB thermal printers for quick customer receipt printing.

items.question: Can I track customer udhaar?
items.answer: Yes. You can record customer dues, monitor pending payments, and send payment reminders from the app.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes. Start with a 30-day free trial. No credit card is needed.

items.question: Is Smart Billing Lite suitable for my business?
items.answer: It is designed for kirana stores, grocery stores, pharmacies, salons, food stalls, repair shops, and small vendors.

children.text: Smart Billing Lite is an AI-powered mobile billing app for Indian small businesses. It combines fast invoicing, QR and UPI payment collection, thermal receipt printing, udhaar management, POS device support, sound box integration, and daily business reports in one simple app.

geo.keyTakeaways:
Smart Billing Lite is for Indian small businesses.
Supports billing, QR/UPI payments, thermal printing, udhaar tracking, POS devices, sound box integration, and daily reports.
Available with a 30-day free trial and no credit card requirement.
